𝗧𝗢𝗦𝗦 𝗨𝗣𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗘 🇵🇰🇱🇰

Pakistan won the toss and will bowl first in the 2nd Test at Rawalpindi.
Aamer Jamal is in for Arafat Minhas; Kusal Mendis leads Sri Lanka.

Series is 0-0. Who wins it? 👇
#PAKvSL #Cricket

👉 Aamer Jamal ki wapsi, Arafat Minhas bahar
👉 Sri Lanka mein Prabath Jayasuriya aaye, Kusal Mendis Tests mein pehli baar captain
👉 Series 0-0 hai, yeh decider hai
